roles.query: WITH category AS (SELECT skill_category, COUNT(*) AS total_skills, SUM(CASE WHEN proficiency_level = N'เชี่ยวชาญ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expert_count FROM skills GROUP BY skill_category) SELECT skill_category, total_skills, expert_count FROM category UNION ALL SELECT N'รวมทั้งหมด' AS skill_category, SUM(total_skills) AS total_skills, SUM(expert_count) AS expert_count FROM category ORDER BY skill_category
